title: TTSManifest
description: Minimal contract letting B-EDIT know the ACTUAL narration timing of each final_script.json block. Produced by a TTS generation step that sits between A-FINAL and B-EDIT and is not yet built -- this file defines only the data contract. TTS timing is measured, not estimated: duration_sec must come from probing the rendered audio file (e.g. scripts/media_probe.py's probe()), never copied from final_script.json's estimated_duration_sec. B-EDIT computes each block's position on the final timeline deterministically as a running sum over final_script.json's block order: block N starts where block N-1 ended.

status.description: pending: no audio rendered yet. generated: at least one block's audio has been rendered and measured -- does not require every final_script.json block to be present here yet.

blocks.description: One entry per final_script.json block whose narration audio has been rendered. Entries may appear in any order -- B-EDIT looks each one up by block_id and reconstructs cumulative timing from final_script.json's own block order, not from this array's order.

audio_path.description: Local path to the rendered narration audio for this block

duration_sec.description: MEASURED duration of audio_path -- e.g. via scripts/media_probe.py's probe(). Never an estimate copied from final_script.json.
